Maya L.: Starting POC with NewBank — stream txns -> call FX tool via function_call -> append structured JSON (rate, src, ttl). Env: VPC + SAML, 30d retention. Need: tiny Node sample, how function_call maps to SDK events, hosted vs reserved pricing for ~1M tokens/mo and 500 qps peak. Timeline 3w.

Ethan R.: Quick checklist: confirm HSM KMS requirement and whether outbound egress from their VPC to FX service is allowed (CIDR).

Maya L.: They prefer HSM but will confirm. Egress allowed with IP allowlist. I'll request IDP metadata + CIDRs.

Priest K.: Short Node example (pseudo, minimal) and schema note:
```js
const s = client.responses.stream({model:'redwood-infer-pro-v1',stream:true,functions:[{name:'fx_lookup',parameters:{type:'object',properties:{pair:{type:'string'},rate:{type:'number'},ttl:{type:'integer'}},required:['pair','rate']}}],function_call:'auto'});
for await (const evt of s){
  if(evt.type==='function_call'){ const tool = JSON.parse(evt.payload); /* tool.rate, tool.ttl */ }
  if(evt.type==='delta') process.stdout.write(evt.chunk);
}
```
Note: function_call events are discrete SDK events; payload is a JSON string when you declare parameters. Always include JSON schema to avoid hallucinated fields. For Private use quantized model variant if cost sensitive.

Priest K.: Fallback routing: prefer Dedicated, fallback to hosted-compatible variant. Fallback preserves function_call plumbing but hosted uses RW-managed keys unless BYOK configured. Recommend a short parity eval.

PricingBot: Hosted on-demand example: ~$0.02/1k tokens => ~ $20/mo for 1M tokens. For sustained 500 qps peaks recommend Dedicated/reserved pool: ballpark $8k-$10k/mo depending on model SLA. HSM/Private adds ~15-25% uplift. Expedited 2-week onboarding is an additional one-time fee.

SecBot: Uploaded security packet and SAML attr template: https://redwood.internal/sec/newbank/secq_173999.pdf. IP allowlist template: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/ip-allowlist-template.md

Maya L.: Action items: 1) I'll email NewBank for IDP metadata, KMS decision, and CIDRs (48h). 2) @PricingBot prepare hosted vs 3mo reserved quote + expedited onboarding line. 3) @Priest spin up a short canary to show latency on q4 vs prod for parity.

Ethan R.: I'll schedule a 15min demo after we get IDP metadata. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
